question: Which of the following cities of Madhya Pradesh were included in the list of UNESCO World Heritage Cities under its Urban Landscaped Cities program in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gwalior and Orchha.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] key points__**

__
 
• In December 2020, **Gwalior and Orchha** were included in the list of UNESCO World Heritage Cities under its Urban Landscaped Cities programme.
 
• The State Government of Madhya Pradesh has selected Orchha and Gwalior as pilot cities for the Historic Urban Landscapes Program and Survey which will be conducted by UNESCO New Delhi in collaboration with Madhya Pradesh Tourism Department.
 
• UNESCO has now included Gwalior and Orchha, the historical fort cities of Madhya Pradesh (India) in its list.
 
• This inclusion is expected to boost tourism potential along with sustainable development for both the cities.
 
• **Gwalior** is an important center of business activities in Madhya Pradesh.
 
 
• Gwalior is home to Gwalior Fort, Man Singh Palace, Sas Bahu Temple and Tansen's Tomb.
 
 
 
• **Orchha is** a popular tourist destination, which attracts tourists from all over the country.
 
 
• Orchha has Orchha Fort, monuments built on the banks of Betwa River, Ram Raja Temple, Kancha Ghat, Dinman Hardaul Mahal and Rani Mahal.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **important point__**

 
• The United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization focuses on everything from teacher training to helping improve education around the world to protecting important historical and cultural sites around the world.

 
 
• **UNESCO protects 1073 World Heritage Sites in 167 countries .**
 
• UNESCO Headquarters in Paris, France
 
• The organization has 193 members and 11 associate members.
 
• There are a total of 40 World Heritage Sites in India .
